to: Stephanie Chavez, Patient Access & Communications Manager, contact form: https://gastroconsa.formstack.com/forms/feedback
subject: A link for your Useful Links page
body:
Hi Stephanie,

A number of your team receive our referral newsletter, so GCSA already knows us. Your Nutrition page mentions the weight-loss balloon program and the link between obesity, GERD and fatty liver. Those are the patients we work with every day, before and after bariatric procedures and alongside weight loss medications.

Would you add us to your Useful Links page (https://www.gastroconsa.com/patient-information/useful-links/)? The page we suggest is our bariatric surgery psychological evaluation page, https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/bariatric-surgery-psychological-evaluation-in-san-antonio-tx/, with the link text "Bariatric Counseling Center: psychological evaluation for bariatric procedures".

In return we will list Gastroenterology Consultants of San Antonio as a referral partner on our website, and we can produce a co-branded printable handout for your patients, "What to expect in the psychological evaluation", with your logo next to ours.

Happy to send a draft of the handout first if that helps. Thank you for considering it.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio
www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com
